whyMatters.en: Reykjavík band formed in 1994. Bowed guitar, Jónsi’s falsetto, and Hopelandic vocals entered post-rock crossover; Takk… (2005) and Hoppípolla widened chart and licensing reach.
whyMatters.zh: 雷克雅未克乐队，1994 年成立。弓奏吉他、Jónsi 假声与 Hopelandic 人声进入 post-rock 跨界；《Takk…》（2005）与《Hoppípolla》扩大榜单与授权触达。

shortBio.en: Icelandic post-rock; Hoppípolla is the accessible Takk… single.
shortBio.zh: 冰岛 post-rock；《Hoppípolla》是易入口的《Takk…》单曲。

body.en:
Sigur Rós formed in Reykjavík in 1994. Ágætis byrjun (1999) and ( ) (2002) established Jónsi’s falsetto, bowed guitar, and orchestral builds; Takk… (2005) added clearer melodic singles.

Hoppípolla (2005) is the chart and licensing entry. They sit with Mogwai and Godspeed on the crescendo map but keep vocal melody and Hopelandic language as primary carriers.
body.zh:
Sigur Rós 于 1994 年在雷克雅未克成立。《Ágætis byrjun》（1999）与《( )》（2002）确立 Jónsi 假声、弓奏吉他与管弦渐强；《Takk…》（2005）加入更清晰的旋律单曲。

《Hoppípolla》（2005）是榜单与授权入口。与 Mogwai、Godspeed 同在 crescendo 地图，但以人声旋律与 Hopelandic 语言为主要载体。

note.en: Slow build to full-band crescendo; Takk… live set centerpiece.
note.zh: 慢建到全乐队 crescendo；《Takk…》现场组曲核心。

body.en:
Sigur Rós merge bowed guitar, reverb-heavy 延音, and Jónsi’s falsetto into post-rock that still reads as song.

Ágætis byrjun (1999) and ( ) (2002) use Hopelandic and non-lexical vocals as texture.

Takk… (2005) adds brass and clearer hooks—Hoppípolla becomes a licensing staple. That widens post-rock beyond wordless crescendo bands.
body.zh:
Sigur Rós 把弓奏吉他、混响 延音 与 Jónsi 假声合并成仍可读作歌曲的 post-rock。

《Ágætis byrjun》（1999）与《( )》（2002）用 Hopelandic 与非词汇人声作质感。

《Takk…》（2005）加铜管与更清晰钩子——《Hoppípolla》成授权常备。这把 post-rock 扩至非仅无人声 crescendo 乐队。

body.en:
1994–2012 core live unit: Jónsi, Georg Hólmar, Orri, Kjartan—bow guitar, bass, drums, keys and brass arrangements.

Kjartan’s departure in 2012 reduces on-stage keyboard and brass; later tours use expanded ensembles.

Jónsi’s bow technique and falsetto stay constant across roster changes. Icelandic studio conditions and long reverb tails are part of the production document.
body.zh:
1994–2012 核心现场单元：Jónsi、Georg Hólmar、Orri、Kjartan——弓吉他、贝斯、鼓、键盘与铜管编配。

Kjartan 2012 年离队减少台上键盘与铜管；后期巡演用扩展编制。

Jónsi 弓技法与假声经阵容变化保持恒定。冰岛录音条件与长混响尾是制作文献的一部分。

title.en: Vocal post-rock for film and charts
title.zh: 影视与榜单的人声 post-rock

body.en:
Sigur Rós showed post-rock could carry melody and language, not only Mogwai-style instrumentals.

My Bloody Valentine’s textural guitar and Radiohead’s ambient turns are audible ancestors.

Hoppípolla and Svefn-g-englar remain sync-licensing references. Later records split critical reception; Takk… and Ágætis byrjun are the citation core.
body.zh:
Sigur Rós 显示 post-rock 可承载旋律与语言，非仅 Mogwai 式器乐。

My Bloody Valentine 质感吉他与 Radiohead ambient 转向是可闻祖先。

《Hoppípolla》与《Svefn-g-englar》仍是同步授权引用。后期唱片评论分裂；《Takk…》与《Ágætis byrjun》是引用核心。
